text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Zephyr-san!
Good morning!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Good morning,
Bakushin O-san... and Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You look as radiant as flower petals dancing on a gentle breeze.
Are you heading out?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. I'm meeting Bourbon-san at the school
gate too... We're going shopping.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr-san, um...
You're wearing your tracksuit even though it's your day off...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. I thought I'd go for a run... to feel the fiery wind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Good job!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're brimming with motivation for our next goal,
the New Zealand Trophy, aren't you!
Here's a gold star from your class rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Maru-san!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My, thank you very much.
...Now then, please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*... Zephyr-san is amazing...
Her aura feels so sharp and tense...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You must have... really strong, powerful feelings
inside you, don't you...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... Whew.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Mmh...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's already empty...
Huh? Zephyr, is that you?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo♪ Out for a run too?
You're way too serious, doing that on your day off~

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding, I was just running too, though!
Nishishi.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio-san—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Tokai Teio.
A classmate from my debut class, and a brilliant prodigy Umamusume everyone has their eyes on.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (And... as for me—)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A-ny-way!
Aren't you thirsty? You've gotta be thirsty, right~?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mmmmmmm~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew~!! Nothing beats this after a good run!
Refreshing Lemon Hachimii!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? It's an all-natural flavor,
so even a picky eater like you can enjoy it,
right?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so. A gentle sweetness, a refreshing tartness...
It's as if a verdant breeze just caressed my throat.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aha, I don't really get it, but if you like it, works for me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Oops. Oh right—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Since we're getting Hachimi, come with me to one more place!
Over here, over here~!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well... She truly is as ceaselessly busy
as a tiny whirlwind, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, Zephyr!
Come on, hurry, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yes, I'm on my way.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (...It's so quiet.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(On race days, the wind whips up
enough to make your head spin. But today is so calm...)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...You know, I actually like it quite a bit.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Just looking out over a quiet Tokyo Racecourse
like this, you know."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Because when we're like this—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That day when Prez won the Japanese Derby
and put herself within reach
of becoming an Undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The cheers and feverish excitement of that day, and that thrilling sensation that zapped straight through my whole body.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Because I can clearly remember all of it!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio-san...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Once summer's over,
autumn and winter will fly by in a flash.
And before you know it, the new year will be here—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Spring of the Classic year is here.
The challenge for the Triple Crown begins!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely pull it off.
I'll definitely become one, just you watch.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: An Undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume, just like Prez!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah. This wind is—
This nostalgic, beloved wind is—)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Amazing......

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, incredible,
...totally, totally amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I, too—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Me too—!

text_block_list.name: Zephyr & Teio
text_block_list.text: I want to be... just like that——...!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ......Precisely.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: So it is... "admiration."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heheheh—yeah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd understand, Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...Yes, most definitely."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I understand very, very well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One holiday evening, on my way back to the Trainer Dorms, I saw Yamanin Zephyr and Tokai Teio in their tracksuits.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm off to Ritto!
See ya later~!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes... See you again.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Were you out running with Teio?
Were you out running with Teio?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
There are other things, too... quite a few, in fact.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Actually—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr quietly told me about her conversation with Tokai Teio. ...It seems she had a truly wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
We are chasing the great heavenly wind.
Both I—and she.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I go the Mile route. She goes the Triple Crown route.
Though the windpaths we follow may differ—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I cannot afford to fall behind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, I can feel the evening calm setting in.
The holiday is already coming to an end, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer-san.
Starting tomorrow... I look forward to training with you again.
